# Risk tier per changed path (Fhi.Munin.DevInfra docs/review-risk-tiers.md, read by risk-tier.py). A file takes the
# first tier, in the order high, medium, low, with a matching glob; a file no glob matches is medium.

# Tokens and sign-in: the package sends the host's bearer token to Munin
high   src/Fhi.Munin.Explorer/Client/BearerTokenHandler.cs

high   src/Fhi.Munin.Explorer/Contracts/IdentityLink.cs
high   src/Fhi.Munin.Explorer/Contracts/MuninExplorerUnauthorizedException.cs
# CI, the package release and what it publishes
high   .github/workflows/*.yml

high   scripts/flatten-release-notes.sh
high   nuget.config
high   Directory.Build.props
high   src/Fhi.Munin.Explorer/Fhi.Munin.Explorer.csproj

low    **/*.md
